Package com.microservices.warehouse.storages.controllers

Class FeatureController

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.warehouse.storages.controllers.FeatureController
@RestController @RequestMapping("api/v1/storage/feature") public class FeatureController extends Object
This controller handles HTTP requests related to features of storage items. It interacts with the FeatureServiceManagement to manage features and updates for storage.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Pouria Ghafarbeigi
